decisions_open_on_no_task_in_thread.name: decisions_open_on_no_task_in_thread
decisions_open_on_no_task_in_thread.where: "decisions"."answered_at" is null and "decisions"."closed_at" is null and "decisions"."task_id" is null

engines_kind.name: engines_kind
engines_kind.value: ("engines"."kind" = 'claude-code' AND "engines"."base_url" IS NULL AND "engines"."key" IS NULL AND "engines"."models" IS NULL) OR ("engines"."kind" = 'openai-compatible-api' AND "engines"."base_url" IS NOT NULL AND "engines"."key" IS NOT NULL AND "engines"."models" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "engines"."claude_code_p") OR ("engines"."kind" = 'codex' AND "engines"."base_url" IS NULL AND "engines"."models" IS NULL AND NOT "engines"."claude_code_p" AND ("engines"."key" IS NULL OR "engines"."key" <> '')) OR ("engines"."kind" = 'copilot-cli' AND "engines"."base_url" IS NULL AND "engines"."models" IS NULL AND NOT "engines"."claude_code_p" AND ("engines"."key" IS NULL OR "engines"."key" <> '')) OR ("engines"."kind" = 'gemini-cli' AND "engines"."base_url" IS NULL AND "engines"."models" IS NULL AND NOT "engines"."claude_code_p" AND ("engines"."key" IS NULL OR "engines"."key" <> ''))

github_sign_in_signed_in_or_out.name: github_sign_in_signed_in_or_out
github_sign_in_signed_in_or_out.value:
("github_sign_in"."login" is not null and "github_sign_in"."access_token" is not null and "github_sign_in"."signed_out_reason" is null)
        or ("github_sign_in"."login" is null and "github_sign_in"."access_token" is null and "github_sign_in"."refresh_token" is null
          and "github_sign_in"."signed_out_reason" is not null)

mcp_servers_connection.name: mcp_servers_connection
mcp_servers_connection.value: ("mcp_servers"."transport" = 'stdio' AND "mcp_servers"."command" IS NOT NULL AND "mcp_servers"."arguments" IS NOT NULL AND "mcp_servers"."url" IS NULL) OR ("mcp_servers"."transport" = 'streamable-http' AND "mcp_servers"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "mcp_servers"."command" IS NULL AND "mcp_servers"."arguments" IS NULL)

skill_uses_library_or_project_skill.name: skill_uses_library_or_project_skill
skill_uses_library_or_project_skill.value: ("skill_uses"."skill_name" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_uses"."project_id" IS NULL AND "skill_uses"."project_skill_key" IS NULL) OR ("skill_uses"."skill_name" IS NULL AND "skill_uses"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_uses"."project_skill_key" IS NOT NULL)

skills_installed_from_source.name: skills_installed_from_source
skills_installed_from_source.value: ("skills"."source" = 'installed') = ("skills"."source_repository" IS NOT NULL AND "skills"."source_folder" IS NOT NULL AND "skills"."pinned_commit" IS NOT NULL)

attachments_link_or_file.name: attachments_link_or_file
attachments_link_or_file.value:
case when "attachments"."kind" = 'link'
        then "attachments"."url" is not null and num_nulls("attachments"."media_type", "attachments"."size") = 2
        else "attachments"."url" is null and num_nonnulls("attachments"."media_type", "attachments"."size") = 2 end

columns.expression: (CASE "priority" WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'normal' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 END)
